scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the hero section displays the product name, tagline, value proposition, and call-to-action buttons correctly (REQ-1, US-1)

steps.description: Navigate to the landing page URL
steps.context: Page should be accessible and load completely

steps.description: Check that the hero section is prominently displayed above the fold
steps.context: Hero section should be the first content visible

steps.description: Check for product name (MirDB), tagline, and value proposition
steps.context: User should understand the product within 10 seconds

steps.description: Check for 'Get Started' primary CTA and 'View on GitHub' secondary CTA
steps.context: Both buttons should be visible and clickable

test_cases.input: Load landing page and query for product name element
test_cases.expected: Element containing 'MirDB' is present and visible in the hero section

test_cases.input: Query for tagline element in hero section
test_cases.expected: Tagline 'Persistent Key-Value Storage with Memcached Compatibility' or similar is displayed

test_cases.input: Query for 'Get Started' button
test_cases.expected: Primary CTA button with text 'Get Started' is visible and has appropriate styling

test_cases.input: Query for 'View on GitHub' or similar secondary CTA
test_cases.expected: Secondary CTA linking to GitHub repository is present

test_cases.input: Check hero section semantic HTML
test_cases.expected: Hero uses semantic elements like <header>, <h1>, with proper heading hierarchy

test_cases.input: Count feature card elements

test_cases.input: Query for 'Persistent Storage' feature

test_cases.input: Query for 'Configurable' feature
test_cases.expected: Feature describing configuration options is present

test_cases.input: Check feature icons are present
test_cases.expected: Each feature card contains an icon element (SVG, image, or icon font)

steps.context: Page should not require horizontal scrolling

steps.description: Check that interactive elements are at least 44px

steps.description: Check that text is readable without zooming
steps.context: Font sizes should be appropriate for mobile

test_cases.expected: Page layout adapts appropriately for tablet viewport

test_cases.input: Check font sizes on mobile

scenarios.name: Accessibility Compliance
scenarios.description: Verify the page meets WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards (NFR-3)

steps.description: Check for proper use of HTML5 semantic elements
steps.context: Should use header, main, nav, section, footer appropriately

steps.description: Check that headings follow a logical h1-h6 order
steps.context: Should have single h1, proper nesting of h2-h6

steps.description: Check that all images have alt attributes
steps.context: Decorative images should have empty alt, informative images should have descriptions

steps.description: Check that all interactive elements are keyboard accessible
steps.context: Should be navigable using Tab key

steps.description: Check that text has sufficient contrast against backgrounds
steps.context: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text

steps.description: Check that focused elements have visible indicators
steps.context: Focus state should be clearly visible

test_cases.input: Check for single h1 element on page
test_cases.expected: Exactly one h1 element exists on the page

test_cases.input: Verify heading hierarchy sequence
test_cases.expected: Headings follow logical order (h1 > h2 > h3) without skipping levels

test_cases.input: Query all img elements for alt attributes
test_cases.expected: All img elements have alt attributes (can be empty for decorative)

test_cases.input: Check semantic landmarks (header, main, footer, nav)
test_cases.expected: Page uses semantic HTML5 landmark elements

test_cases.input: Tab through all interactive elements
test_cases.expected: All buttons and links are focusable via keyboard in logical order

test_cases.input: Check focus indicator visibility on buttons
test_cases.expected: Focused buttons have visible focus rings or outlines

test_cases.input: Analyze color contrast of primary text
test_cases.expected: Text color has at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio against background

test_cases.input: Check for skip navigation link
test_cases.expected: Skip to main content link is present for keyboard users (optional but recommended)

test_cases.input: Check button and link accessible names
test_cases.expected: All interactive elements have accessible names (visible text or aria-label)
